test_policy.notes: "Denison practices no-harm, test-optional admission." Scores are not required, any submitted scores are superscored, and scores that do not help are ignored. Applicants have not been required to submit ACT or SAT scores since 2008 (international page). Common Data Set C8 agrees: 'Not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

requirements.supplemental_essays: None required (the page says 'No supplemental essay required'); the personal essay is part of the Common App or Coalition application.
requirements.notes: Common App or Coalition application (no difference in how they are evaluated); no application fee. Required from others: counselor recommendation and school report, official high school transcript, and at least one teacher evaluation from a core-course teacher. Interviews are recommended, not required ("the majority of successful applicants complete an interview"). Optional arts supplement for cinema, creative writing, dance, music, studio art or theatre. All international applicants must submit the Denison University Certification of Finances (free; in the applicant portal) even if they do not want aid. Early Decision applicants also sign an Early Decision Agreement. The CSS Profile is not accepted from international applicants. International applicants must show English proficiency (see english_policy).

deadlines.label: Early Decision 1
deadlines.notes: Binding. The page prints no year; read as the 2026-27 cycle because it is live in Nov 2026. The first-year page says ED decisions come about 1 month after each ED deadline (the international page says 'within a few weeks'); all decisions are final on April 1. Aid applicants submit the Denison Certification of Finances by the same date. No early action.

deadlines.label: Early Decision 2
deadlines.notes: Binding. The page prints no year; read as the 2026-27 cycle. Decision about 1 month after the deadline. Certification of Finances due the same date.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: The page prints no year; read as the 2026-27 cycle. The international deadlines equal the first-year ones. First-year page: decisions by mid-March (the international page says late March). Certification of Finances due the same date.

english_policy.waiver_notes: "All international applicants must demonstrate adequate English proficiency to qualify for admission." Considerations include English as the primary language of school instruction, English as the first language, TOEFL iBT, IELTS, Duolingo English Test, SAT Reading, ACT English and an admission interview. "English proficiency waivers are considered on a case-by-case basis after a student applies for admission." The 2026-27 catalog lists the benchmarks TOEFL iBT 80+, TOEFL Essentials 8.5+, IELTS 6.5+, Duolingo 115+, SAT Reading 600+ and ACT English 26+ (TOEFL Essentials has no row here).

english.notes: Catalog: 'TOEFL iBT of 80+' is listed among the considerations, not as a hard minimum. Old 0-120 scale; no new-scale (1-6) figure is published.
Catalog: 'IELTS of 6.5+' is listed among the considerations, not as a hard minimum.
Catalog: 'Duolingo English Test (DET) of 115+' is listed among the considerations, not as a hard minimum.

aid.notes: "Denison offers exactly the same need-based financial aid and merit-based scholarships to international students as it does to U.S. citizens and permanent residents, and Denison meets 100% of each student's demonstrated financial need." On whether it is need-aware for internationals: "Denison is need-aware in the application process as this allows us to meet 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted students." Aid is requested only at application: check the aid box and submit the Denison Certification of Finances (required of ALL international applicants; free; no CSS Profile, which Denison does not accept from international students) by the admission deadline (Nov 15 ED1, Jan 15 ED2 and RD). International students who enroll without need-based aid cannot apply for it later. Merit scholarships (all applicants considered) range from $5,000 a year to full tuition. The Common Data Set reports 358 aided nonresidents with an average institutional award of $55,613.

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the Denison pages read; pick the college by name on the College Board form.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the Denison pages read.

toefl.note: No TOEFL or IELTS code is printed on the pages read.

tier_notes.general: Selective liberal-arts college in Ohio (2,385 of 12,202 applicants admitted, SAT middle 50% 1270-1420 among submitters, test-optional); placed with Santa Clara and Syracuse (B), below Vassar (B++).
tier_notes.computer_science: Computer Science (plus Data Analytics and Machine Learning and AI) in a small liberal-arts college; one band below Pomona's CS tier (C).
tier_notes.business: No business major; Global Commerce, Finance and Organizational Strategy and Leadership are the closest programs (catalog course-of-study list).
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Biology, Neuroscience and Chemistry and Biochemistry in a small liberal-arts college; one band below Pomona (B).
tier_notes.pre_med: Liberal-arts science route to health careers; one band below Pomona and Swarthmore (B).
tier_notes.economics: Economics (also Philosophy, Politics and Economics); one band below Pomona and Swarthmore (B).
tier_notes.math_physics: Mathematics and Applied Mathematics, Physics and Astronomy; one band below Pomona and Swarthmore (B).
tier_notes.humanities: Broad humanities offering (English, History, Philosophy, Religion, languages); tier is a judgment call, set one band below the general tier like the other subject areas.
tier_notes.arts_design: Dance, Music, Music Theatre, Theatre, Cinema and Visual Arts; same band as Pomona (C).
tier_notes.engineering: No engineering degree appears in the 2026-27 catalog course-of-study list.
